title: Wind turbine tower mode
line: A reference wind turbine drawn to scale, colored by its tower's first fore-aft mode.
description: The NREL 5-MW reference turbine (Jonkman et al. 2009, NREL/TP-500-38060), drawn to scale, with the tower colored by its first fore-aft mode from a beam model built on the report's Table 6-1 (rotor and nacelle as 350 t at the top). Deflection exaggerated.
thumbnailAlt: Wind turbine tower mode, drawn by RunMat
